methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page (accessed 2026-06-14 unless noted). Google Maps Platform subscription plans (Starter/Essentials/Pro) confirmed from mapsplatform.google.com/pricing; pay-as-you-go free-tier credits per SKU confirmed same page. Mapbox has no flat monthly subscription for API products — all billing is usage-metered; rates sourced from mapbox.com/pricing (multiple sub-sections). HERE Technologies pricing page (here.com/get-started/pricing) renders JavaScript-only and returned no data in repeated fetch attempts; HERE is therefore listed as quote-only (monthlyUsd=null for all plans). TomTom offers Freemium (free daily quota with no flat fee) and Pay As You Grow (usage-metered above that daily free quota); per-request rates sourced from developer.tomtom.com/store/maps-api. Radar publishes no self-serve pricing; pricing page only shows a demo/quote request form. MapTiler Cloud prices sourced from maptiler.com/cloud/pricing/. LocationIQ prices sourced from locationiq.com/pricing. Geoapify prices sourced from geoapify.com/pricing. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical. monthlyUsd for usage-metered plans with no flat tier = null; published unit rates are in notes.
